issue: Sixth carriage exterior texture breaks on close hover / revisit
root_cause: DetailTextures patched and restored the same material; Three reuses cached programs and uniforms and can keep disposed session textures on reattachment. Switching direct/composer paths exposes further program variants.
fix: Session-owned cloned branding materials; restore original mesh material references and dispose clones on release. Base textures, UV, geometry unchanged.
